pull.title: KAFKA-21255: Return Streams assignments when all owned task sets are reported (4.3)
pull.body:
Backport of #23768 to 4.3.  Preserve the existing endpoint cache and
epoch update conditions when resending assignments.

This backport branch is based on the 4.3 branch
(da7f7e71bef077faa4398f6563986b4c7b6cc06b)

Reviewers: Lucas Brutschy <lbrutschy@confluent.io>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended The focused behavior change preserves existing endpoint-update conditions and has regression coverage, with only a nonblocking spelling correction remaining.
1 open issue - [Correct spelling of acknowledging](https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/23970#discussion_r4388148950) · New
What changed in this PR Backports KAFKA-21255 to Kafka 4.3 so Streams clients can recover missed assignments by reporting all three owned task sets, including empty sets. **Changes:** - Resend current assignments while preserving existing endpoint-cache invalidation and epoch-update conditions. - Add regression tests for lost responses involving epoch changes, revocations, and same-epoch assignments. - Update integration tests to expect echoed assignments and wait for nonempty standby assignments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `group-coordinator/​src/​test/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​coordinator/​group/​GroupMetadataManagerTest.java` | Adds response-loss recovery tests and updates assignment expectations. | | `group-coordinator/​src/​main/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​coordinator/​group/​GroupMetadataManager.java` | Separates assignment resending from endpoint-cache and epoch updates. | | `core/​src/​test/​scala/​unit/​kafka/​server/​StreamsGroupHeartbeatRequestTest.scala` | Adjusts standby polling and restart assertions for echoed assignments. |
Review effort: Balanced

commit.message:
KAFKA-21255: Return Streams assignments when all owned task sets are reported (4.3)

Backport of #23768 to 4.3.

Preserve the existing endpoint cache and epoch update conditions
when resending assignments.

files.patch:
@@ -26,7 +26,7 @@ import org.apache.kafka.common.test.api.{ClusterConfigProperty, ClusterFeature,
 import org.apache.kafka.coordinator.group.GroupCoordinatorConfig
 import org.apache.kafka.common.errors.UnsupportedVersionException
 import org.apache.kafka.server.common.Feature
-import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.{assertEquals, assertNotNull, assertNull, assertThrows, assertTrue}
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.{assertEquals, assertNotNull, assertThrows, assertTrue}
 
 import scala.jdk.CollectionConverters._
 
@@ -763,7 +763,7 @@ class StreamsGroupHeartbeatRequestTest(cluster: ClusterInstance) extends GroupCo
       val options = new org.apache.kafka.clients.admin.AlterConfigsOptions()
       admin.incrementalAlterConfigs(configChanges, options).all().get()
 
-      // Send heartbeats to trigger rebalance after config change
+      // Wait for standby tasks: heartbeats can echo the old assignment before the config change takes effect.
       TestUtils.waitUntilTrue(() => {
         streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse1 = streamsGroupHeartbeat(
           groupId = groupId,
@@ -775,8 +775,9 @@ class StreamsGroupHeartbeatRequestTest(cluster: ClusterInstance) extends GroupCo
           warmupTasks = List.empty
         )
         streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse1.errorCode == Errors.NONE.code() &&
-          streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse1.standbyTasks() != null
-      }, "First member heartbeat after config change did not succeed within the timeout period.")
+          streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse1.standbyTasks() != null &&
+          !streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse1.standbyTasks().isEmpty
+      }, "First member did not receive standby tasks after config change within the timeout period.")
 
       TestUtils.waitUntilTrue(() => {
         streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse2 = streamsGroupHeartbeat(
@@ -789,8 +790,9 @@ class StreamsGroupHeartbeatRequestTest(cluster: ClusterInstance) extends GroupCo
           warmupTasks = List.empty
         )
         streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse2.errorCode == Errors.NONE.code() &&
-          streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse2.standbyTasks() != null
-      }, "Second member heartbeat after config change did not succeed within the timeout period.")
+          streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse2.standbyTasks() != null &&
+          !streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse2.standbyTasks().isEmpty
+      }, "Second member did not receive standby tasks after config change within the timeout period.")
 
       // Verify that at least one member has active tasks
       val member1ActiveTasksNum = streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse1.activeTasks().size()
@@ -980,6 +982,8 @@ class StreamsGroupHeartbeatRequestTest(cluster: ClusterInstance) extends GroupCo
       assertEquals(2, streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.memberEpoch())
       assertNotNull(streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.activeTasks())
 
+      val assignmentBeforeRestart = streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.duplicate()
+
       // Restart the only running broker
       val broker = cluster.brokers().values().iterator().next()
       cluster.shutdownBroker(broker.config.brokerId)
@@ -999,13 +1003,12 @@ class StreamsGroupHeartbeatRequestTest(cluster: ClusterInstance) extends GroupCo
         streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.errorCode == Errors.NONE.code()
       }, "StreamsGroupHeartbeatRequest after broker restart did not succeed within the timeout period.")
 
-      // Verify the response. Epoch should not have changed and null assignments determine that no
-      // change in old assignment
+      // The epoch and assignment should be unchanged. Reporting all owned tasks echoes the assignment.
       assertEquals(memberId, streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.memberId())
       assertEquals(2, streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.memberEpoch())
-      assertNull(streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.activeTasks())
-      assertNull(streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.standbyTasks())
-      assertNull(streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.warmupTasks())
+      assertEquals(assignmentBeforeRestart.activeTasks(), streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.activeTasks())
+      assertEquals(assignmentBeforeRestart.standbyTasks(), streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.standbyTasks())
+      assertEquals(assignmentBeforeRestart.warmupTasks(), streamsGroupHeartbeatResponse.warmupTasks())
 
     } finally {
       admin.close()
